identity.title: Create safe same-grid Thickness recipe variants

origin.kind: 2026-08-17 actual Release EXE ten-recipe UX and performance study
origin.summary: Repeating the same Thickness teaching across grid-compatible C3D inputs required about 33 UI actions and exposed a controlled-Error Run Record serialization failure.

state.current_summary: PL-0015 is complete: ten varied Thickness recipes match their controlled outcomes, same-grid variants preserve safe authored state without implicit execution, repeated authoring is 11 actions, fixture speed targets pass, and controlled Error Run Records serialize without non-finite metrics.

objective.summary: Let an operator reuse a saved direct-grid Thickness setup with another same-size C3D input while preserving explicit execution and evidence boundaries.
constraints: Keep the original recipe unchanged and save the variant as a separate recipe.
Preserve only direct C3D GridRectangle selections whose compatibility can be proved by grid size and source identity.
Do not invoke Preview, Publish, Run, or Validation during setup, restore, or variant creation.
Treat generated raw-height fixtures as software evidence, not calibrated physical metrology.

criteria.text: A grid-compatible variant preserves ordered steps, typed routes, parameters, stable direct-grid ROI identities and coordinates, and rebinds source content identity while leaving the original unchanged.
Variant setup rejects unsafe selection kinds and different grid dimensions, performs no implicit execution, and is immediately reusable for another variant.
Ten varied current-schema Thickness recipes match their expected controlled states and meet the documented workstation action and timing targets.
A controlled Error with non-finite internal metrics writes a valid Run Record that retains status and message and omits non-finite JSON values.

context.summary: Owns safe compatible-source variant validation and creation.
Owns JSON-safe finite metric projection for Run Records.

evidence.observation: Recipe Manager/WPG passed 52/52, including same-grid preservation, source rebinding, mismatch rejection, no-action setup, separate save, cleared transient evidence, and immediate next-variant command availability.

evidence.kind: actual Release EXE UI and workflow observation
evidence.observation: On dynamically selected leftmost DISPLAY2, actual Wide and Compact Recipe Center and variant setup remained bounded. Samples 5 through 10 used 11 observed actions per repeated recipe versus the 33-action baseline, with explicit Preview and Publish retained.

evidence.kind: ten-sample deterministic replay and performance evidence
evidence.observation: Ten generated 1280 x 840 C3D inputs and ten recipes matched Pass 4, Fail 5, Error 1. Repeated authoring was 11 actions, variant readiness was observed no later than 1.916 seconds, ordered replay stayed at or below 244.75 ms including final Error replay, and the Thickness step stayed at or below 15.02 ms.

Artifact-owned ordered Runner verification passed 19/19, including omission of positive infinity, negative infinity, and NaN while retaining controlled Error. Sample 9 wrote a valid Error Run Record with zero non-finite metrics.

evidence.kind: ten-sample deterministic replay and final performance evidence
evidence.observation: The manifest proves ten generated 1280 x 840 C3D inputs and ten recipes matched Pass 4, Fail 5, Error 1, with ordered replay at or below 241.94 ms and the Thickness step at or below 15.02 ms. The final rebuilt sample 9 record remained the expected Error at 244.7521 ms with zero metrics, so the combined measured maximum stayed below the 250 ms target.

events.summary: Selected the existing Recipe Center and first-use workflow as the narrow owner of a safe same-grid source variant; numerical inspection behavior remains unchanged.

Resolved after actual EXE ten-recipe operation, 66.7% repeated-action reduction, target-conforming replay, current Wide/Compact review, focused regression, full Release build, and controlled-Error Run Record export passed.
